newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - May 15.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Thursday's Daily Variety:

* Hollywood's most powerful money manager, Gordon Crawford, is looking to broker a deal between News Corp Ltd and Time Warner Inc to end their dispute over carriage of the Fox News Channel and help News' satellite TV efforts.
* Speculation is mounting over Walt Disney Co's ABC network plans for its fall lineup of primetime shows.
* Regency Enterprises has closed an exclusive output deal with France's digital television consortium Television Par Satellite, which apparently has irked Canal Plus.
* The Arts Council of England was set to announce the award of up to four film production franchises funded by national lottery money.
* Jonathan Krane is set to produce five projects, including an adaptation of Peter Maas' bestselling bio of mobster Sammy (The Bull) Gravano and two vehicles for John Travolta.
